nodes.label: Inter font family (Inter-Regular/SemiBold/Bold.ttf)
nodes.rationale: Dropping the Inter TTF files into assets/fonts/ gives the app real typography instead of ImGui's built-in pixel font; the app still runs and falls back to the default font if the files are absent.

nodes.label: JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf (optional monospace font)
nodes.rationale: Optional font used specifically for the process table's numeric columns; the app falls back gracefully if it is absent.
